description: This file contains selectors and utility functions related to user custom statuses in the Mattermost web application, including fetching, expiration checking, recent statuses, and UI display logic.

methods.name: makeGetCustomStatus
methods.description: Creates a selector to retrieve a user's custom status, parsing JSON stored in user props.

methods.name: isCustomStatusExpired
methods.description: Checks if a custom status has expired based on current time and its expiry timestamp.

methods.name: getRecentCustomStatuses
methods.description: Retrieves recent custom statuses, filtering out those with emojis not present in the emoji map.

methods.name: isCustomStatusEnabled
methods.description: Determines if custom user statuses are enabled in the current configuration.

methods.name: showCustomStatusPulsatingDotAndPostHeader
methods.description: Determines whether to show UI indicators for custom status, based on user creation date and tutorial modal view.

methods.name: showStatusDropdownPulsatingDot
methods.description: Wrapper for UI indicator logic for status dropdown.

methods.name: showPostHeaderUpdateStatusButton
methods.description: Wrapper for UI indicator logic for post header status update button.
